weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入射手座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往射手座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天最重要的是把您的親人擺在第一位。您可能會感到不知所措，覺得根本沒有時間陪伴孩子或伴侶。當您將自己的需求放在次要位置時，要平衡所有事情可能會有困難。您可能會發現自己陷入義務與自身限制之間的兩難境地。為了緩和這種內心的掙扎，請在接下來的幾週專注於做出深思熟慮的決定。
aries.horoscope_en: Today is all about prioritizing your loved ones, Aries. You might feel overwhelmed, claiming there's simply no time to dedicate to your children or partner. With your own needs taking a backseat, it can be challenging to balance everything. You may find yourself caught between obligations and your own limitations. To ease this internal struggle, focus on making thoughtful decisions in the coming weeks.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，一位朋友或親戚可能正在暗中破壞你們之間的關係。然而，最近的誤會可能會是因禍得福。它促使您面對自己對不明確、曖昧關係的不適感。不妨考慮今天花點時間寫一封信給這個人；結果可能會讓您感到欣喜若狂。
taurus.horoscope_en: A friend or relative may be subtly undermining your bond, Taurus. However, a recent misunderstanding could turn out to be a blessing in disguise. It’s prompting you to confront your discomfort with unclear, ambiguous connections. Consider taking the time today to pen a letter to this individual; you might be pleasantly surprised by the outcome.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，您最近一直在社交圈中穿梭！這個充滿活力的階段相當振奮人心，但也可能令人精疲力竭。雖然您的一些新關係引起了您的興趣，但其他關係可能會讓您感到不快。今天，特別是某個人可能會讓您感到有些焦慮。您發現自己正處於十字路口：您可以完全離開這個新朋友圈，也可以對讓您感到不安的人採取堅決態度。
gemini.horoscope_en: Lately, you've been fluttering through social circles, Gemini! This vibrant phase is quite energizing but can also be draining. While some of your new connections spark your interest, others may rub you the wrong way. Today, one individual in particular is likely to stir up some anxiety for you. You find yourself at a crossroads: you can either walk away from this new friend group altogether or take a stand against the person who's been causing you distress.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今天您的敏感度可能會提高，讓您感覺比平時更加脆弱。如果您在公共場合、工作場所或螢幕上遇到任何攻擊行為，都可能會加深您的無助感。不過，別讓這件事迫使您退縮。在這個經常缺乏同情心的世界中，您是少數幾個擁有同情心的人，因此您扮演著重要的角色。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, your sensitivity may be heightened, making you feel more exposed than usual. If you encounter any displays of aggression, whether in public, at your workplace, or on screen, it could amplify your sense of vulnerability. However, don’t allow this to push you into retreat. As one of the rare keepers of compassion in a world that often lacks it, you have an important role to play.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，雖然有些人可能會覺得您有點強勢，但今天您可能會覺得總是當領頭羊很累。您的朋友可以提供寶貴的見解，幫助您更客觀地看待各種情況，避免在面對每個挑戰時過於情緒化。把握機會放鬆一下，好好休息一次吧！
leo.horoscope_en: While some may perceive you as a bit forceful, Leo, today you might find yourself weary of always taking the lead. Your friends can offer valuable insights, helping you to view situations more objectively and avoid getting too emotionally wrapped up in every challenge. Embrace the opportunity to unwind and take a break for once!

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天您可能會覺得自己比平時更敏感一些。這種敏感度提高可能會導致煩躁和內心衝突的感覺，特別是在您對長期專案的完成產生懷疑時。現在是反思的完美時刻。想想您幾個月前開始的那個專案延遲的原因；很可能有一個合理的解釋。聽取周圍人的建議，有助於引導您回到正軌。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you might find yourself feeling a bit more sensitive than usual. This heightened sensitivity could lead to feelings of irritability and inner conflict, especially as doubts arise about the completion of your long-term projects. It's a perfect moment for reflection. Consider the reasons behind the delays in that project you started months ago; there’s likely a valid explanation. Listening to the advice of those around you can help guide you back on track.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天可能會感到有點困惑，因為發生的事情超出了邏輯的範疇。許多發生的事情會在更深層的潛意識層面產生共鳴，難以直接理解。您昨晚可能做了一個夢，深入分析一下這個夢可能會有所幫助。如果您願意放下分析思維，您可能會發現今天對您來說充滿無限潛力。
libra.horoscope_en: Today may feel a bit perplexing, Libra, as events unfold beyond the realm of logic. Much of what transpires will resonate on a deeper, subconscious level, eluding straightforward understanding. You might have experienced a dream last night that could benefit from a deeper analysis. If you're willing to set aside your analytical mind, you could find today holds great potential for you.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，您可能正感受到當前圍繞著我們所有人的混亂所帶來的壓力。在這樣的動盪時期，有些人會緊抓傳統不放，在信仰上變得更加僵化，這是一種常見的反應。雖然您與生俱來的敏感性讓您傾向於回顧過去，但此刻需要您放下一些長期堅持的信念，擁抱周圍正在發生的變化。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, you're likely feeling the weight of the current confusion that surrounds us all. It's a common reaction for some to cling tightly to tradition during such tumultuous times, becoming more inflexible in their beliefs. While your innate sensitivity draws you to the past, this moment calls for you to release some of those long-held convictions and embrace the changes unfolding around you.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，是什麼阻礙了您？宇宙正在推動您放下過時的目標，擁抱新的成長機會。您可能會發現自己開始質疑那些曾經感覺很穩固的事情。透過思考最壞的情況，您可能會發現自己所堅持的並不像您想像中那麼重要。現在是放下過去、踏上新旅程的時刻。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, what’s holding you back? The cosmos is nudging you to release outdated goals and embrace fresh opportunities for growth. You might find yourself questioning things that once felt solid. By contemplating the worst-case scenario, you may discover that what you’re holding onto isn’t as significant as you thought. Now is the moment to release the past and embark on a new journey.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，請記住，您不必獨自面對挑戰。您周圍有些人真心理解您，並渴望伸出援手。他們的意圖是純粹的，完全出於愛與支持。雖然您保持謹慎是人之常情，但請放心，這些關心您的人是真心誠意的。事實上，您今天可能剛好有機會與其中一位建立聯繫！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, remember that you don't have to tackle your challenges alone. There are people around you who genuinely understand and are eager to lend a hand. Their intentions are pure, driven solely by love and support. While it's natural for you to be cautious, rest assured that these caring individuals are real. In fact, you might just find the opportunity to connect with one of them today!

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，您是否覺得延誤正成為家常便飯？今天也不例外。一項預期的活動或事項再次被延後。也許是文件弄丟了，或者發生了意料之外的狀況，導致事情進展緩慢。即使您平時的沉著態度也可能會受到一點考驗！撐住；一切很快就會解決。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, have you felt like delays are becoming a regular occurrence? Today is no different. An anticipated event or item is once again postponed. Perhaps the paperwork went astray, or an unexpected hiccup has slowed things down. Even your typically calm demeanor might be feeling a bit tested! Hang in there; everything will be sorted out soon.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，走進大自然，動起來吧！如果您今天有機會休息一下，這是一個釋放壓力的絕佳機會。回想一下您的童年，那時競爭讓您感到快樂。還記得競賽跑到山頂的快感嗎？重新找回那些令人興奮的感覺，可能會大大提升您的生活品質。
pisces.horoscope_en: Step into the great outdoors and get active, Pisces! If you have the chance to take a break today, it's the perfect opportunity to let off some steam. Think back to your childhood when competition brought you joy. Recall the thrill of racing to the top of the hill? Reconnecting with those exhilarating feelings could significantly enhance your life.
